width.definition: Number of active qubits (touched by ≥1 non-directive operation) in the compiled circuit; evidence `logical`

size.definition: `circuit.size()` of the compiled circuit (directives excluded; measurements and resets included); evidence `logical`

two_qubit_count.definition: Number of instructions with `operation.num_qubits == 2` in the compiled circuit; evidence `logical` and `logical_multi_qubit_ops` (≥3-qubit ops)

two_qubit_depth.definition: `circuit.depth(filter_function=lambda i: i.operation.num_qubits == 2 and not directive)` on the compiled circuit; evidence `logical`

toffoli_count.definition: Number of `ccx` instructions (and `mcx` with exactly 2 controls) in the **logical** circuit

routing_overhead.definition: `(R − A) / R` where `R` = `two_qubit_count` of the representative compile and `A` = the minimum two-qubit count over the all-to-all reference compiles (same basis, same seeds). `R = 0` → value 0.0. May be slightly negative (stochastic compiles); report as is. Evidence: `R`, `A`, `swaps_inserted`, the five qubit pairs with the most SWAPs

swaps_inserted.definition: Number of `swap` instructions in the `route_only` output for the representative seed; evidence: per-pair counts

compile_ratio.definition: `R / L0` where `L0` = two-qubit count of the RAW_TRANSLATION. `L0 = 0` → `unavailable` ("no two-qubit operations")

reliability_heuristic.definition: `exp(Σ log(1 − e_op))` over compiled gates and measurements with error data (`target[op_name][qargs].error`; `None` or 0 for virtual `rz` contributes nothing). An operation with `e ≥ 1` is faulty (the backend calibration marks it unusable): the value is exactly 0; faulty operations are listed in evidence `faulty_ops` (`[{op, qargs, error, count}]`, sorted by qargs, then op) and left out of the per-qubit/per-edge contributions, and `total_neg_log` is `null`. `e > 1` is not a valid error rate: the metric fails with `ValueError` naming the op and qargs (ChP-0041). Evidence: per-qubit and per-edge contributions of `−log(1 − e)`, the five largest contributors, `ops_without_error`, `faulty_ops`. Label everywhere: **"calibration-based reliability heuristic, not a success probability"**

scheduled_duration.definition: Critical-path duration of the compiled circuit from ALAP scheduling with the target's durations; evidence `ratio_to_median_t2` = duration ÷ median T2 of the active physical qubits, `median_t2_s`

seed_spread.definition: `(max − min) / median` of `two_qubit_count` across seeds; evidence: min, median, max, per-seed table

supermarq_profile.definition: SupermarQ's six features on the logical circuit: program communication, critical depth, entanglement ratio, parallelism, liveness, measurement. Port the published formulas (cite the SupermarQ paper/source in `docs/metrics.md`). Shown, never scored. Where a feature's formula divides by zero (program communication with < 2 qubits; entanglement ratio with no gates; liveness or measurement with depth 0), the feature is 0.0 and the case is listed in `evidence.undefined_as_zero` (ChP-0026)

entanglement_variance.definition: Population variance of `c_i`, the number of two-qubit operations touching logical qubit `i`, over active logical qubits. Evidence: per-qubit counts, mean, `cv = std / mean` (0 when mean = 0). Inspired by QASMBench's entanglement variance; not identical, and `docs/metrics.md` says so

structure.definition: On the logical circuit: (a) **commuting runs**: maximal connected DAG runs of two-qubit gates diagonal in the computational basis (`cz`, `cp`, `crz`, `rzz`), where one-qubit diagonal gates (`rz`, `p`, `z`, `s`, `sdg`, `t`, `tdg`) do not break a run; (b) **Clifford blocks** via `CollectCliffords`; (c) **linear-function blocks** via `CollectLinearFunctions`. Each with qubits, layer range and gate indices

resynthesis_potential.definition: Σ over two-qubit blocks of the compiled circuit (`Collect2qBlocks` + `ConsolidateBlocks`) of `current two-qubit gates in the block − (two-qubit gates in TwoQubitBasisDecomposer(<target's 2q gate>)(block unitary))`, i.e. the count of the exact KAK synthesis (basis fidelity 1). (`num_basis_gates` is not used: in Qiskit 2.5.2 it returns 0 for SWAP-class blocks at some global phases; ChP-0043.) Evidence: top blocks with locations, and the same sum on the RAW_TRANSLATION (`raw_potential`, informational: level 3 usually realizes it)

scalability.definition: For each `size_sweep` value: rebuild through `intake/loaders.py` (sandbox), compile with the first 3 seeds, record logical (RAW_TRANSLATION) and compiled two-qubit counts and `routing_overhead`. Fit `y = a·n^b` by least squares on `log y` vs `log n`, where `n` = qubit count of the built circuit. Value `{b_logical, b_compiled, r2_logical, r2_compiled}`; evidence: per-size table (arg value, qubits, counts, overhead). No `size_sweep` → `unavailable`. MVP caps the sweep at three sizes after G2 (cut list)

simulated_task_score.definition: Noisy simulation of the **representative compiled circuit** under the target's noise model (`AerSimulator.from_backend(...)` or a noise model from the calibration snapshot), compared with the ideal result. Higher is better, in [0, 1]: `known_output` → P(bitstring) noisy; `distribution` → `hellinger_fidelity(ideal_probs, noisy_counts)`; `expectation` → `1 − |E_noisy − E_ideal| / Σ|coeff|`. Evidence always includes the intent's own criterion (`p`, `fidelity`, or `abs_error = |E_noisy − E_ideal|`, plus `E_ideal`, `E_noisy`). ≥ 5 trials (seeds derived from item hash and trial index); `value` = mean; `uncertainty.ci95` = mean ± t₀.₉₇₅,ₙ₋₁·s/√n. Method chosen by the planner (`09-gpu-and-simulation.md`). No task → `unavailable` ("intent has no task")

mirror_score.definition: Probability of returning to `|0…0⟩` after the compiled circuit followed by its inverse, under noise; same trials/CI rules. **Label: "noise accumulation (mirror circuit), not task quality."** Selected by default only for items whose intent has no task; never substituted into `simulated_task_score`

D01.title: Routing-dominated
D01.evidence: `R`, `A`, SWAPs inserted, the qubit pairs that needed them
D01.region: Compiled: layers/qubits where SWAPs were inserted (from `route_only`, mapped to the representative compile via layout)

D02.title: Seed-sensitive
D02.strategies: More seeds; always report best of N (no request is built)

D03.title: Commuting block
D03.condition: A commuting run with `≥ 6` two-qubit ops on `≥ 4` qubits

D04.title: Resynthesizable blocks
D04.evidence: Each block's current vs minimum two-qubit gates

D05.title: Clifford or linear block
D05.condition: A Clifford or linear-function block of `3–9` qubits (AI synthesis handles Clifford and linear blocks up to 9 qubits)

D06.title: Reliability hot spot
D06.condition: One qubit or edge carries `≥ 25 %` of total `−log reliability`, or the compiled circuit uses a faulty operation (`faulty_ops` non-empty; severity high, or info under `info_rules`; threshold `faulty_ops` 0 with margin = number of distinct faulty ops; evidence lists every faulty op with its count; region: the faulty qubits/edges) (ChP-0041)

D09.title: Poor scaling
D09.condition: Routing overhead rises monotonically across ≥3 sweep sizes, or `b_compiled − b_logical ≥ 0.3`
D09.strategies: Routing strategies; flag for the researcher

D10.title: Low task score
D10.condition: Intent criterion fails: `known_output` p < `task.min_probability`; `distribution` fidelity < `1 − task.tolerance`; `expectation` abs_error > `task.tolerance`
D10.strategies: "Work the other findings first"; report plainly (no request)
